audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown appears anywhere on the page, including for the two abilities the advice is built around.
audit.why: Alpha Strike is 20s at rank 1 and — critically — his basic attacks reduce it, so it returns faster than a fixed count suggests. Meditate is a flat 10s, which is why chip damage alone never finishes him. Highlander is a flat 85s.
audit.corrected: The 10s Meditate written into spikes[2], the 85s Highlander into late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three real errors. (a) spikes[0], early and wants.you[1] all say Disdain flips or cancels his Alpha Strike approach — Master Yi is UNTARGETABLE for the whole dash, so the flip cannot connect during it. (b) whys[6] and late call Urgot's Echoing Flames legs 'true damage'; Riot's text says physical damage and there is no trueDamage flag in his kit — the true damage in this matchup is Wuju Style, on HIS side. (c) Highlander makes him immune to all slowing effects, which blanks both Corrosive Charge's slow and Purge's slow while it is up — the single most important interaction in the lane, and it is stated nowhere.
audit.why: (a) teaches the player to spend their only gap-closer into a window where the target does not exist. (c) is worse: the entire kiting plan silently stops working for the duration of his ultimate, and the page never warns them.
audit.corrected: Disdain re-keyed to the Alpha Strike LANDING; the legs described as Echoing Flames without the damage-type claim, with Wuju Style named as the true damage; Highlander's slow immunity and 85s cooldown written into late.
sources: enemyKit Q untargetable flag and text
enemyKit R text: 'immune to all slowing effects'

audit.whatIsWrong: Meditate heals him on a flat 10s and nothing on the page mentions Grievous Wounds.
audit.why: Urgot's damage pattern is sustained chip from Purge and Echoing Flames — precisely what a repeatable self-heal undoes. Anti-heal timing decides every extended trade here.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds and the 10s Meditate added to spikes[2].
sources: enemyKit W heal flag and cd

audit.whatIsWrong: mid and spikes[1] say Meditate 'cannot channel through a suppress'.
audit.why: Suppression is not stated anywhere in Riot's text for Fear Beyond Death, so the claim rests on an unverified mechanic. The verifiable version is stronger and simpler: Meditate is a channel, and any CC cancels it — and Urgot's R is hard CC.
audit.corrected: Reworded to 'Meditate is a channel your R's lockdown cancels outright' in both fields.
sources: enemyKit W channel flag: 'interruptible — any CC cancels it'
